name: Biota.blockchain (BioDAO.X)
tagline: AI-driven platform for personalized therapies, with blockchain transparency and a DAO framework

zones.name: Personalized Therapy Lab
zones.purpose: AI and molecular modeling to optimize AGI compounds for rare and neurodegenerative diseases (ALS, Parkinson's)
zones.source: ~/Downloads/Project Name-  AGI Corp-  Curable.X.pdf, p.1, Q1 and Q3

zones.name: DAO Governance Hall
zones.purpose: Each agency or organization runs its own DAO for governance, resource allocation and policy-making
zones.source: ~/Downloads/Project Name-  AGI Corp-  Curable.X.pdf, Security Application, Key Components: DAO Integration

zones.name: Multi-Blockchain Ledger
zones.purpose: Interoperable ledgers (Ethereum, Hyperledger, Polkadot, Cosmos) for verified cross-network data
zones.source: ~/Downloads/Project Name-  AGI Corp-  Curable.X.pdf, Security Application, Key Components: Multi-Blockchain Integration

zones.name: Healthcare Data Exchange
zones.purpose: Encrypted patient data sharing with smart-contract access and SMS patient consent
zones.source: ~/Downloads/Project Name-  AGI Corp-  Curable.X.pdf, Use Case Scenarios, 3. Healthcare Data Exchange and Security

zones.name: Biopharma AGI Agents Hub
zones.purpose: Hub linking biopharma agent roles such as Research & Development and Clinical Support

agents.name: Health Agent

agents.source: ~/Downloads/Project Name-  AGI Corp-  Curable.X.pdf, Key Components: Specialized AGI Agents; Use Case 3

agents.name: Security Agent
agents.role: Monitors blockchain transactions for potential threats
agents.source: ~/Downloads/Project Name-  AGI Corp-  Curable.X.pdf, Key Components: Specialized AGI Agents

agents.name: Compliance Agent

agents.source: ~/Downloads/Project Name-  AGI Corp-  Curable.X.pdf, Key Components: Specialized AGI Agents

agents.name: Finance Agent
agents.role: Scans blockchain transactions for fraud patterns and triggers DAO notifications
agents.source: ~/Downloads/Project Name-  AGI Corp-  Curable.X.pdf, Use Case Scenarios, 2. Financial Compliance and Fraud Detection

agents.name: Communication Agent
agents.role: Specialized AGI agent for secure communication (phone 2FA, encrypted messaging)
agents.source: ~/Downloads/Project Name-  AGI Corp-  Curable.X.pdf, Key Components: Specialized AGI Agents; Phone Number Authentication
